items.raw_snippet: # AI Drives New Era of Wealth Management M&A, According to InvestmentNews. According to *InvestmentNews*, industry leaders believe the influence of AI on transaction activity will continue to grow as advisory firms seek greater efficiency and scalability. As *InvestmentNews* reports, merger and acquisition activity remains strong across the wealth management industry. Fidelity's April 2026 Wealth Management M&A Transaction Report showed that median deal size increased significantly, while private equity-backed buyers participated in most transactions. Derek Bruton, managing director and head of M&A at Modern Wealth Management, told *InvestmentNews* that technology and AI have become increasingly embedded throughout the acquisition process. He explained that advisory firms face mounting pressure to invest in infrastructure, data capabilities, and integrated client experiences, factors that continue to drive consolidation across the industry. Mike Wilson, chief executive officer and co-founder of Hamachi.ai, told *InvestmentNews* that AI is improving the experience for both buyers and sellers. According to *InvestmentNews*, these capabilities can streamline the transaction process and improve the quality of information available to prospective buyers.

items.snippet: # Google CEO Sundar Pichai: Orchestrate AI Agents Now or Fall Behind by 2027. Go...
items.raw_snippet: # Google CEO Sundar Pichai: Orchestrate AI Agents Now or Fall Behind by 2027. Google CEO Sundar Pichai has issued a compelling and urgent call to action for individuals and organizations alike: "If you don't learn to how to orchestrate agents now, you'll spend 2027 catching up to people who started today." This statement isn't just a casual observation about emerging technology; it's a direct warning about the seismic shift that artificial intelligence, specifically in the form of intelligent agents, is poised to bring. This post is for professionals, students, and business leaders who want to understand the implications of AI agents and how to prepare for the future. By the end, you will have a clear understanding of what AI agent orchestration entails, why it's becoming critical, and actionable steps you can take today to gain a competitive advantage. The term "orchestrate AI agents" might sound complex, but at its heart, it refers to the skill of managing, coordinating, and directing multiple AI agents to work together harmoniously and effectively towards a common goal.

items.snippet: Dario Oliveira Neto serves as a senior scholar of competition policy at the Inte...
items.raw_snippet: Dario Oliveira Neto serves as a senior scholar of competition policy at the International Center for Law & Economics. Mario Zúñiga serves as a senior scholar of competition policy at the International Center for Law & Economics. It issued part of its long-awaited decisions on a batch of AI partnership agreements and “acqui-hire” deals between Big Tech firms and AI startups. Three cases escaped formal notification, and the one that did not—Microsoft/Inflection—had already been cleared on the merits by the United Kingdom’s Competition and Markets Authority (CMA). It starts with the basics of Brazil’s merger-notification regime, then examines how the Tribunal characterized “acqui-hire” and “reverse acqui-hire” arrangements as “concentration acts.” It then asks what distinguished Microsoft/Inflection from Google/Character.AI on the “call-in” question, summarizes the outcome of each case, and closes with a substantive critique of the killer-acquisition theory CADE has imported. The question, in the end, is whether Brazil’s Competition Law has the doctrinal board to ride that wave safely.
